# Expertise Registry

## Policy

This system must work without third-party technical skills.

If a trusted external skill exists, it may be installed and mapped to a reviewer subagent.

If no external skill exists, reviewers use:
- existing repo patterns;
- language tooling;
- compiler / typecheck;
- lint;
- tests;
- general model knowledge;
- the user's review lens and accumulated feedback.

A missing entry never blocks work — it only lowers the level of specialized expertise.

## Entries

### <stack, e.g. TypeScript>
- status: <installed | missing | candidate>
- skill: <skill name, e.g. typescript-quality>
- source: <where it comes from>
- trust_level: <high | medium | low>
- notes: <evaluation notes>

### <stack, e.g. React>
- status: missing
- skill:
- source:
- trust_level:
- notes:
